task_boundaries.must_include: Compare studies only on matched compounds, matrices, endpoints, and conditions; avoid ranking technologies when the evidence is not comparable.
task_boundaries.must_not_claim: Do not convert a condition-specific finding into a universal PFAS treatment claim.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2023 - Smaili - Adsorption as a remediation technology for short-chain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from water - a critical review.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: In the reviewed sorbent comparison, removal efficiency of long-chain PFAS is higher than that of short-chain PFAS across the sorbents considered.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2025 - Kebede - Adsorptive Removal of PFAS from Aqueous Solutions Using GAC, PAC and Ball-Milled Colloidal Activated Carbon - Characterizing Efficiency, Kinetics,.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: For GAC, PAC, and ball-milled colloidal activated carbon, long-chain PFAS (PFOA: 73% ± 24%, PFOS: 89% ± 35%) showed higher removal efficiency than short-chain PFAS (PFBA: 30% ± 11%, PFBS: 55% ± 18%).
gold_evidence.method_or_material: GAC; PAC; ball-milled colloidal activated carbon

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2023 - Smaili - Adsorption as a remediation technology for short-chain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from water - a critical review.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: Overall removal efficiency of short-chain PFAS is much lower than that of long-chain PFAS (e.g., PFOS 98.8%, PFOA 87.6%), attributed to short-chain PFAS' low hydrophobicity.
gold_evidence.does_not_support: Specific short-chain values (PFBA 2.1%, PFPeA 1.1%) and the sorbent identity PEI-f-CMC are not in the selected span.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2026 - Sadmani - A critical review of the application of biochar in removing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from water matrices.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: In the reviewed adsorption literature, longer-chain PFAS are described as more hydrophobic and less water-soluble, leading to higher adsorption capacities onto adsorbents.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2025 - Hamza - Understanding PFAS Adsorption - How Molecular Structure Affects Sustainable Water Treatment.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: In the discussed adsorption context, long-chain PFAS can interact through hydrophobic tails and hydrophobic interactions, while short-chain PFAS have fewer fluorine moieties and show less hydrophobic interaction, with electrostatic interaction becoming dominant in that type of adsorption.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2022 - Vu - Recent progress in adsorptive removal of per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from water-wastewater.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: While removal efficiencies are often better for long-chained, carboxylic, and linear PFAS, contradictory results are frequently reported across different waters, adsorbents, and experimental conditions, and many influencing factors remain unknown.
gold_evidence.does_not_support: The universal claim that longer chain always yields higher removal without exceptions.
gold_evidence.limitation: Many factors remain unknown and contradictory results exist across waters/adsorbents/conditions.

question.question_text: How can PFAS compound class or headgroup affect treatment performance or equilibrium behavior?

task_boundaries.must_include: Compare studies only on matched compounds, matrices, endpoints, and conditions; avoid ranking technologies when the evidence is not comparable.
task_boundaries.must_not_claim: Do not convert a condition-specific finding into a universal PFAS treatment claim.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2025 - Saha - Foam fractionation of PFAS from landfill leachate using a membrane electrochemical reactor.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: In landfill leachate, PFSAs were removed more efficiently than PFCAs after seven hours of operation, with 98.3% PFSA removal versus 85.5% PFCA removal; short-chain PFSAs (C≤6, 92.5–99.1%) were removed more efficiently than short-chain PFCAs (C≤6, 80.8–90%), possibly due to stronger air-water interface affinity enhancing foam-based separation.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2025 - Meng - Complete Aqueous Defluorination of GenX Hexafluoropropylene Oxide Dimer Acid Anion by Pulsed.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: The chemical identity of the PFAS headgroup did not govern PFAS adsorption on laser-made [Ni0.75Fe0.25]-(OH)2–hydrophilic carbon fiber paper anodes.
gold_evidence.does_not_support: Headgroup identity always affects PFAS adsorption.
gold_evidence.method_or_material: pulsed electrolysis on [Ni0.75Fe0.25]-(OH)2–hydrophilic carbon fiber paper anodes
gold_evidence.limitation: Specific to this anode material and conditions

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2021 - Liu - Pilot-scale field demonstration of a hybrid nanofiltration and UV-sulfite treatment train for groundwater contaminated by per- and polyfluoroalkyl.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: FHxSA is likely neutral at pH 7.3 due to its sulfonamide headgroup, and its NF rejection [SOURCE_TEXT_OMITTED sha256=758ba2be39ee3364095f450595244f9ce3784f0d556272a7be756c3aeb8f6bd9].
gold_evidence.limitation: Headgroup charge effect is pH-dependent

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2023 - Lauwers - Adsorption of PFAS by All-Silica Zeolite β - Insights into the Effect of the Water Matrix, Regeneration of the Material, and Continuous PFAS.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: All-silica zeolite β has lower adsorption capacity and affinity for sulfonic acids than for carboxylic acids, attributed to the more polar sulfonic moiety and lack of dimer formation.
gold_evidence.limitation: Specific to this adsorbent

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2023 - Wang - Removing per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in water by foam fractionation.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: In the cited removal example, PFHeA removal was 55% overall, much less than PFHeS removal at 96% overall.
gold_evidence.limitation: Span is truncated/garbled ('PFHxA was removed Y.')

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2026 - Sadmani - A critical review of the application of biochar in removing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from water matrices.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: With ZVI or ZVI+BC, PFSAs were removed up to 94% compared to PFCAs up to 60%.
gold_evidence.limitation: Review citing secondary source; values reported 'up to'

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2025 - Uwayezu - Efficient removal of PFAS in groundwater and landfill leachate using iron-modified peat residues and electrochemical oxidation.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: Column treatment retained sulfonate PFAS more than carboxylate PFAS with equal chain length, e.g., 84% PFOS vs 72% PFNA removal.

question.question_text: Does longer empty-bed contact time necessarily translate into better PFAS performance in granular activated carbon systems?

task_boundaries.must_include: Use limitation, uncertainty, caveat, and negative evidence to avoid overclaiming beyond the reported study scope.
task_boundaries.must_not_claim: Do not convert a condition-specific finding into a universal PFAS treatment claim.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2019 - Park - Adsorption of perfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in groundwater by granular activated carbons - Roles of hydrophobicity of PFAS and carbon.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: The apparent adsorption capacity did not change as EBCT increased.
gold_evidence.limitation: single-study GAC adsorption observation

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2020 - Zeng - Removing per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances from groundwaters using activated carbon.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: Lead+Lag to Lead column ratios for qΣPFAS were near unity (1.07 ± 0.12), implying adsorption mechanisms are independent of EBCT.
gold_evidence.protocol_detail: Lead + Lag vs Lead column configuration, Table S8

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2020 - Zeng - Removing per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances from groundwaters using activated carbon.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: Longer EBCTs did not suffer from competing adsorbates, and similar breakthrough curve shapes suggest shorter EBCTs (~2–5 min) capture the mass transfer zone.

gold_evidence.doc_id: 2022 - Kempisty - Granular activated carbon adsorption of perfluoroalkyl acids from ground and surface.pdf
gold_evidence.supported_claim: No consistent trend was observed whereby either shorter or longer EBCTs resulted in lower carbon usage rates (CURs) for PFAAs.
gold_evidence.limitation: specific EBCT values (13/26 min) not verifiable in selected span
